In the closing months of the year 310 a human by the name Gite Staffwrung accomplished something few mortals could ever think possible, namely the slaying of an immortal guardian who has persisted through the ages terrorizing the dwarves of the Righteous crest.

Stren Gorgesnarled the Raptor of Glades

Stren Gorgesnarled the Raptor of Glades is a figure in history little known to races other than the dwarves, Some worship the great mountain titan, others fear it for the Dwarven Capital of Bim Ud has known its wrath throughout the ages.

According to dwarven scholars since time immemorial Stren Gorgesnarled the mountain titan has presented itself to battle to the mountainhalls of Bim Ud almost every decade killing many notable figures who would meet it in battle in the hills of the dwarven capital city.

The 3rd time the beast arrived the second King of Bim Ud and the genesis of much of dwarven culture Kumil Inkedblockades met the titan and was slain in the year 34.

In the year 59 the 9th time the titan came Queen Kadol Girdertired also gave her life only four years into her reign to banish the titan back to its shrine in the mountains.

And finally in the year 232 the greatest blow was dealt, King Etur Haleoar, The last surviving member of the Inkedblockades dynasty met the titan in a duel on the dark stone of the mountain and was slain thus ending a dynasty which had directed dwarven culture for some 200 years.

This was not the end for the dwarves of Bim Ud as the titan would attack several more times over the coming years to take its appeasement in blood.

Present day

not much is known of Gite staffwrung although the human Axeman now resides in the city of oilcombats, most evenings he can be found in the tavern retelling his story.

It goes as such:

In late malachite after working as a mercenary in Regaltorches with his companion ber Palacegloves the macedwarf in the dwarven hill settlement of Regaltorches one night over a few too many drinks Ber told Gite of the terrible beast known only to the dwarves of Bim Ud and the stories passed through the ages, truthfully he believed that the titan was the reason that the dwarven kingdoms had not grown beyond the western mountains.

Intrigued and seeking fame Gite suggested they should hunt down this eldritch beast and put an end to its oppresion of the dwarves and in the morning they set off to Oilcombats, the dwarven town at the foot of the Righteous Crest, along the way figuring they needed help they recruited a Speardwarf by the name of Rith Cobrabasement and refilled their supplies.

On their journey they learned that Rith had some motivation to kill the scourge of the dwarves, As it happened Rith Cobrabasement was the great-great-great grandson of King Kumil Inkedblockades and although thinly blooded enough not to be considered nobility he saw it as his duty to leave his family in Oilcombats and avenge his ancestors spirit.

The journey through the mountains was hard and perilous and for two weeks they wandered about unsure if the titan existed at all in these lands.

Then they saw a ruined shrine, long overgrown and buried in a grove and approached carefully, Whentye peered over the crest they saw it.

Rushing headlong into battle Gite, Ber and rith hacked at the beasts flanks with their weapons, Flame chased up the valley as the beast howled, trembling the ground.

Rith did not fare so well.

The battle went on for what seemed like hours, trading blows they wrought a deadly toll on the beast, until finally it gave out and died, Unfortunately Rith could not be saved.

Upon inspecting the Shrine they came across many bodies of long dead historical figures including the burned skull of the elven author and counsellor to King Etur Haleoar, Alatha Dancejungle who died in the attack alongside the fabled king.

Gite placed the skull in his backpack as proof of the deed they had accomplished, knowing any part of the titans body would simply be too large to carry.

Upon arriving back in OilCombats they were greeted as heroes by the nobility and questioning from the locals and they now reside there to this day.
Gite Staffwrung and Ber Palacegloves, Slayers of the great titan.
